claims.input: Real homogeneous rank-one-convex quartic F on R^(m x 2), explicit mu_F>0, smooth fixed unit direction, connected bounded Lipschitz planar domain or torus, admissible nonnegative amplitude boundary and positive fourth mass
claims.output: Every amplitude minimizer is positive in the interior; bounded below globally on a torus or with strictly positive continuous boundary amplitude
claims.mechanism: Convex mass-value supporting slope makes the minimizer a signed Q=1 minimum of a scalar p-growth functional; DiBenedetto-Trudinger (1984) Corollary 3 applies with zero additive forcing
claims.limitations: No automatic classification supplying mu>0, no smoothness or uniform lower bound independent of phase, no all-direction energy sign

claims.input: Same fixed-direction assumptions; torus or strictly positive boundary for the global Picone comparison
claims.output: Mass-value I_g is C1 on positive masses; nonnegative amplitude minimizer is unique; derivative is the unique radial multiplier

claims.input: Additionally planar left-SO(2) invariance, torus or strictly positive boundary amplitude
claims.output: Optimal weak flux j=partial_a f_k(grad r/r), j in L^(4/3), div j in L1, has exactly constant Fenchel residual lambda; torus ess-inf dual and boundary dual with weak normal trace are attained
claims.boundary_contract: I_g(M)=lambda M+beta_j(g^4)/4, beta defined by a bounded W1,4 extension; the classical pointwise normal trace is not assumed
claims.cost: Variational groundstate and weak flux existence; computing them or a smooth pointwise certificate has UNKNOWN cost
claims.not_claimed: Smooth dual attainment, global unweighted flux for zero boundary amplitudes, or quasiconvexity

claims.output: At zero background on the torus, unrestricted smooth-direction normalized amplitude infimum is zero if periodic Jensen holds and minus infinity if any negative periodic test exists; this remains true for directions inside one fixed hemisphere
claims.witness_mechanism: Target translation to remove zeros, spatial replication u(Nx)+c with unchanged fourth mass and energy factor N^4
claims.scope: Zero-background periodic Jensen only; not asserted equivalent to all-background quasiconvexity
